text:
Maria K.: Quick sync — got 3 overlapping leads this morning where marketplace and an SI both flagged the same account. Can we lock intake rules so we stop duplicating outreach?

Ajay R.: Ack — which accounts?

Maria K.: ACME, Nimbus, and one federal account. My proposal: SI owns the lead if either `si_referred=true` OR the SI initiated a demo/requested intro within 7 days of intake. Otherwise marketplace leads go to SDR queue.

Noah P.: 7 days sounds right for enterprise. 72h was too short. Also require evidence (email thread or partner_oppty_id) before we hand to SI — prevents claim-stuffing.

Sara L.: +1. Also add an enrichment step before handoff so SI teams get a cleaned contact (company size, role, verified email). We can run a nightly enrichment job (Clearbit/ZO).

Ajay R.: CRM mapping needs to be explicit. Fields we should add: `ref_source` (marketplace|si|direct), `si_partner_id`, `partner_oppty_id`, `lead_intake_ts`. Also recommend a computed `preferred_owner` field used by routing rules.

Maria K.: Good. Also marketplace checkout should set `marketplace_conversion=true` automatically so ops can prioritize renewals/upsells.

integrations-bot: New webhook template created for lead intake: POST /webhooks/lead-intake. Sample payload below.

Ajay R.: ```json
{
  "account": "ACME Corp",
  "contact_email": "j.smith@acme.com",
  "ref_source": "marketplace",
  "si_partner_id": null,
  "partner_oppty_id": "",
  "marketplace_conversion": false,
  "lead_intake_ts": 1719004321
}
```

Sara L.: Who will own enforcement and exceptions? I suggest Partnership Ops owns exceptions, Sales Ops owns routing config, Partnerships owns weekly triage report.

Maria K.: That split works. Weekly report to include: counts by `ref_source`, number of overlapping claims, avg time-to-handoff, and manual overrides.

Noah P.: Please add an audit log for handoffs (who claimed, timestamp, evidence link). Retention 90 days minimum for audits. :eyes:

Ajay R.: I'll add the routing rules to the automation playbook and push the Salesforce inbound field mapping. Will run a 2-week canary on EMEA partners first. @Maria K. can you own the partner_id mapping sheet for the canary? :thumbsup:

Maria K.: Yep — will update the sheet with top 20 EMEA partner ids and mark co-sell tiers.

integrations-bot: Created INT-224 to add CRM fields + webhook + audit-log hook (https://redwood.example/t/INT-224).

Sara L.: Great — thanks team. After the canary we should run a small SI feedback loop (3 partners) to surface edge cases.

Noah P.: Agreed. Schedule follow-up 2 weeks after canary start.

Maria K.: Splitting tasks: Ajay -> automation + SFDC mapping; Integrations -> webhook + fields (INT-224); Maria -> partner id sheet; Sara -> enrichment pipeline plan; Noah -> audit spec + post-canary feedback. Back here with PRs by EOD tomorrow?

Ajay R.: On it.

integrations-bot: Automated reminder set for 1719007921 to check canary metrics.
